title: Regulating AI 'not the right place to start' says Bailey
summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey warned that simply regulating artificial intelligence is insufficient, emphasizing the need for rigorous testing and robust safeguards to mitigate risks. He argued that a focus on regulation alone would miss the broader safety challenges posed by AI development.

title: Practical Secrets Extraction against Black-box LLMs
summary: The paper introduces a black‑box framework for extracting confidential credentials that large language models may have memorized, even when only output‑only API access is available. It combines cross‑validated secret knowledge distillation to build a local proxy model with proxy‑guided extraction techniques that leverage truncated top‑p sampling, token entropy, and structural priors to efficiently recover secrets. Experiments on controlled benchmarks and real‑world LLM services (OpenAI and Claude Code) demonstrate higher recovery rates and lower latency than prior methods, highlighting the practical risk of secret leakage from commercial LLMs.

title: Same Patient, Conflicting Documents: Can AI Preserve the Evidence?
summary: The article presents a synthetic experiment using the Symptomato platform to illustrate how missing source documents can conceal conflicts in patient data, even when the final aggregated value appears correct. It explores whether AI techniques can detect and preserve such hidden evidence, highlighting challenges in medical data integrity and the role of machine learning in resolving them.
